## Cover direction

**Color grading specialist:** Two hierarchies were drafted and one was kept. The route sits under the title, in the same order as rail over log. The surface uses one grey scale and one restrained blue. Each state reads by glyph shape, never by hue alone.

**Wayfinding designer:** The poster gets one quiet surface and one strong edge. A 6px blue bar stands directly before the failed Test node. Nothing else on the canvas carries that weight. The failed glyph has its word beside it: "Test · failed".

**Camera operator:** The whole idea fits in one frame at thumbnail size. The poster breaks the frame in one place only. A retry loop rises out of the Test node and returns to it. A check sits at the top of the loop. There are no other marks of motion.

**Amber crab:** The retry steps sideways and comes back. The loop leaves Test and re-enters it instead of skipping ahead. Package and Deploy preview wait as hollow rings on a dashed line. The one action that matters is the only curved line on the canvas.

**Lead's choice**

- **Composition:** The title fills the upper left in two lines. The task descriptor sits under it, and the date sits top right. A navy band across the lower third carries the six-step route at y 490. The left half is solid, with filled dots for Install, Lint and Build. The blue signal edge comes next, then the slashed Test ring with its loop and check. The blocked segment trails right in dashes.
- **Palette:** The background is #111316, with text in #e7e9ec and muted marks in #9aa1ab. The single accent is #6fa8dc. Sam Creates navy #0E2A47 is the route band. Red #BE4D4D appears only as the slash through the failed ring and one short rule.
- **Type treatment:** The title uses Cover Headline at 100px in two lines with tight leading. The descriptor uses Cover Text at 26px in muted grey. The date uses Cover Text at 20px and the Test label uses it at 18px.
